description: PRODUCT BLOCKER (per platform) if no embedding model runs acceptably on WebGPU or WASM. Measure latency on 1.5-3 s windows at ~1 Hz, WebGPU vs WASM, numerical drift vs reference EER. Desktop evidence: CAM++ runs fully on native WebGPU (drift 2e-5) but at 198 ms p50 vs 40 ms on WASM; fails on JSEP (AveragePool ceil_mode unimplemented).
title: Benchmark speaker embedding (CAM++, WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM, ECAPA-TDNN, ReDimNet2-B6) on WebGPU/WASM
